snippet.title: Vidrush AI lets you create Entire Youtube Videos In minutes in any sty;e you want
snippet.description:
You can now build entire YouTube channels using this one AI tool.

It's called VidRush. It's the world's first AI tool that can turn your simple text prompts into full 1-hour-long documentary videos, entirely on its own.

You just give it a video idea. No script, no footage, no editing knowledge required.

VidRush researches the topic and writes a complete script for you. It pulls from real sources, fact-checks the angles, and structures it like a proper documentary.

Then it scans the entire internet to find real-world footage that matches your story. Stock clips, archival footage, news segments, whatever fits the scene.

And if it can't find the right clip, it automatically generates custom motion graphics to fill the gap. So your video never has those awkward black screens or repeated b-roll.

From there, it adds the voiceover, on-screen text, smooth transitions, and sound effects. Every layer pro editors usually spend hours on.

Think of it like a full production studio compressed into one tool. Writer, researcher, editor, voice actor, and motion designer, all rolled into one.

Finally, it loads everything into an editing timeline. You can adjust any part of the video just by chatting with it.

Change a scene, swap a clip, rewrite a line. All through plain text, no timeline knowledge needed.

And just like that, your long-form video is ready to upload. The kind that used to take a team a full week now happens in one sitting.

#vidrush #aiyoutube #aivideos #aiautomation #youtubeautomation

snippet.title: Google just launched AI Pointer that puts an AI Agent behind your mouse cursor
snippet.description:
Google just changed how your mouse works.

They put an AI agent behind your cursor that sees exactly what you see and understands what you're pointing at.

It's called Google AI Pointer. Text, images, tables, code, anything on your screen, it reads instantly.

So instead of typing out a 200 word prompt, you just point at something and tell it what to do. The cursor does the rest.

Think of it like giving your mouse a brain. Same clicks, same movements, but now it actually understands what's underneath it.

Hover over a messy spreadsheet. Ask it to merge these two columns. It's done in seconds.

Point at an image and say move this here.

Boom, it edits the image in place without opening Photoshop or any external tool.

Pause a travel video on a restaurant. Point at the screen.

You instantly get a live booking link with hours, menu, and reviews.

The use cases keep stacking from there. Translate any text on screen without copying it. Get a summary of a long PDF by hovering over a section.

Even pull product prices from any e-commerce site just by pointing at the item.

It works across your entire browser.

No extensions needed, no separate app, no third-party plugins to install.

The tool is currently in early beta. So access is limited and rolling out slowly to select users right now.

For researchers, designers, marketers, and anyone working across multiple tabs all day, this saves the kind of time that adds up to full days every month.

#Googleai #googledeepmind #aimouse #aipointer #aiagent
